Sweeping across centuries of global history, the authors argue that ethnic allegiances and national sentiments are deeply embedded in human evolution, kinship systems, and shared cultures. From ancient empires and city-states to modern republics, this book offers a refreshing, multi-disciplinary perspective on why political ethnicity remains one of the most powerful and enduring forces in world politics. Key Areas of Analysis: Evolutionary Perspective: Connects human kinship, culture, and ancient tribal structures to modern geopolitical boundaries. This critical volume systematically breaks down his extensive bibliography, offering deep textual analysis and historical context for both his celebrated masterpieces and his lesser-known short stories. The contributing authors explore the evolving ideologies embedded within Heinlein’s works, tracking his transition from early libertarian ideals to complex musings on military duty, individualism, and sexuality. About: There is an invisible ancient thread running through our collective human consciousness—a golden tether that binds us not only to the earth but to all that crawls, soars, prowls and sings upon it ... On each page of Animals , a new emotional experience awaits the reader. A sizeable bull sits lazily in a sari shop, a monkey watches over the glittering night lights of a hill town, a horse offers the photographer and his shuttering device a hilarious sidelong glance. Then there are images of walls lined with the snarling severed heads of big cats, elephants performing at a circus, unsuspecting gharials being forced out of a pond too close to a village. In this profound juxtaposition rests an enduring hope—to rekindle the spirit of coexistence amongst all living beings. Through the visionary lens of one of the countrys leading photojournalists, Raghu Rai, witness another India that remains mostly unnoticed—or otherwise viciously brutalized. Instead, he asserts that political stability and legitimate laws are divine and historical in origin, slowly growing out of a nation's organic traditions, heritage, and deep-rooted spiritual landscape. About: Alasdair Nairn’s Engines That Move Markets: Technology Investing from Railroads to the Internet is an absolute masterpiece of financial literature that investigates the cyclical nature of disruptive innovation and stock market valuations. Nairn takes readers on a fascinating historical tour, analyzing the profound economic transformations brought about by paradigm-shifting technologies—ranging from the rise of canals and railroads to the expansion of the telegraph, automobiles, electricity, and the modern internet boom. However, beyond the speculative dust settled, the underlying technologies ultimately mature to structurally reshape global commerce. This book carefully dissects how to distinguish long-term commercial winners from short-lived hype, offering timeless lessons on asset valuation and market psychology. Title: IFGC 2018 (International Fuel Gas Code)
Author: International Code Council
Topics: Business, Business/economy/marketing/
About: Addresses the design and installation of fuel gas systems and gas fired appliances through prescriptive and performance requirements. Key changes include: A new Section was added to recognize arc-resistant CSST products. The code now allows Schedule 10 steel pipe to be used, whereas previously, Schedule 40 was the lightest steel pipe material allowed. Schedule 10 steel pipe joints are allowed to be welded, brazed, flanged or assembled with press-connect fittings. Schedule 10 pipe cannot be threaded. The code clarifies that appliance shutoff valves located behind movable appliances, such as ranges and clothes dryers, are considered to be provided with the required access. The code now calls for the plastic vent pipe material to be labeled as complying with the standards for the specific pipe material as called out by the manufacturer. As an alternative, the plastic pipe can always be listed to UL1738. The clearances between direct-vent appliance vent terminals and openings in the building exterior that could allow combustion products to enter the building have been revised.
